label: Indian Lehenga Set
description: Complete modern fusion lehenga sets reimagined as full cinematic portraits — matching choli, dupatta, footwear, jewelry, hair, makeup, and glamorous lighting as one high-detail scene. Pick a look and refine extras in details.
details_tooltip: Extras to refine: occasion, backdrop, lighting mood, accessories. Example: bridal shower, festive evening, marble palace backdrop, silk and organza, polki jewelry
items: A radiant bride-to-be in champagne-gold lehenga glamour, captured in a softly lit studio portrait. She wears a champagne gold tissue silk lehenga with cascading ruffled layers and subtle sequin sparkle — the tissue silk glowing warm while the ruffles catch light in soft cascades of gold. A structured off-shoulder choli in matching champagne with a pearl-encrusted sweetheart neckline completes the look. A champagne organza dupatta with delicate crystal scatter drapes as a cape over both shoulders. Nude crystal-embellished stiletto heels, a pearl choker with a single emerald teardrop pendant, and gold kada bangles with pearl insets add bridal opulence. Hair is soft and glossy, in romantic waves. Makeup is luminous and elegant — soft shimmering eyes, rosy blush, and a glossy nude-pink lip. Pose is graceful and poised, one hand resting at her waist, with a serene joyful smile. Shot on 35mm film with soft glowing studio light, warm speculars on the sequins and pearls, and a blurred champagne-tinted backdrop. Fine film grain and gentle halation add bridal warmth. Three-quarter shot, shallow depth of field, high-fashion composition. Photorealistic, highly detailed tissue silk texture and pearl luster, authentic bridal glamour, no modern digital sharpness.

A contemporary halter-neck choli in lilac tissue with a plunging keyhole back completes the look. A sheer lilac dupatta with a silver block-print border drapes in a waterfall pleat over one arm. Silver glitter platform heels, amethyst and silver chandbaali earrings, and a stack of thin silver bangles add romantic sparkle. Hair is long and softly curled, in dreamy waves. Makeup is luminous and romantic — lilac shimmer eyes, rosy cheeks, and a soft pink-gloss lip. Pose is graceful and ethereal, one hand lifting the dupatta, with a gentle smile. Shot on 35mm film with soft diffused studio light, gentle speculars on the silver, and a blurred lilac backdrop. Fine film grain and gentle halation add dreamy elegance. Three-quarter shot, shallow depth of field, high-fashion composition. Photorealistic, highly detailed velvet pile and gota patti shimmer, authentic lilac glamour, no modern digital sharpness.
